file_list_assertion: All 36 accession-scoped RAWs mapped exactly once: four population/genotype groups x three mouse replicate codes x three fraction files.
biological_evidence: PRIDE sample protocol identifies FACS-sorted preMegE and preCFU-E bone marrow cells. Filenames encode WT or KO and three source codes per group. Publication states biological replicates represent individual mice. The same group/source code is repeated across suffixes 1, 2, X, consistent with three SCX fractions from each source.
technical_evidence: PRIDE protocol documents sequential LysC and trypsin digestion; both recorded. Three SCX eluates at 75 mM ammonium acetate, 300 mM ammonium acetate, and 5% ammonium hydroxide. Orbitrap Fusion top-speed DDA, 400-1500 m/z, 1.6 m/z isolation, HCD 30 NCE.
limitations: The third fraction file suffix X is interpreted as the third SCX eluate from its consistent pairing with 1 and 2; no depositor-provided explicit suffix key. Mouse sex and age not disclosed.
